title: pastinaca palmata
intro: Pastinaca palmata, commonly known as wild parsnip, is a biennial or perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant's health benefits include its use as a diuretic and as a treatment for various digestive issues, such as bloating and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Pastinaca palmata include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
